svg.title: Men's service cap (wheel cap) for the Honor Guard, rear chinstrap up

crown ellipse, visor and cloud/bolt/dart placement read off the 10x render (base-art/rank-traces/capdev-src/cap_*_10x.png); no cap was measured; the strap loop measured on the Class A guard figure of \"CAP Honor Guard Uniform Guidance\" (page 4, 6x render, crop origin 780,2530: crown 493 px across = 43.6 px/in, strap legs 22 px wide at x 359..380 px on the left and 650..671 px on the right at y 245, bottom outline at y 402 px, 120 px = 2.75 in below the visor's lowest point, buckle slash at x 430..447, y 357..373, slide at x 565..605, y 372..388); drawn as a loop of a leather strap, buckle on the wearer's right (the viewer's left): 9.6.7.9.2 puts the buckle to the right of centre seen from the rear","anchors":{"top_center":[575,0],"bottom_center":[575,690],"center":[575,345],"left_edge":[0,345],"right_edge":[1150,345],"device_slot_center":[575,156.29999999999998],"garment_attach_center":[575,459.99999999999994],"band_top_center":[575,285],"visor_center":[575,569.9999999999999],"front_center":[575,345],"chin_strap_left_button":[230,481],"chin_strap_right_button":[920,481]},"landmarks":{"device_slot":{"x":475,"y":56.3,"w":200,"h":200},"band":{"x":204.99999999999997,"y":285,"w":740,"h":175}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); device_slot is a nominal 2 in box centred where the CAP service cap insignia sits (centred on the front of the crown)","dimensions":{"crown_w_in":11.3,"crown_h_in":3.84,"crown_top_to_band_top_in":2.75,"band_w_in":7.4,"band_h_in":1.75,"visor_drop_in":2.25,"clouds_and_darts_per_side":0,"visor":"black","chinstrap_position":"up: the black leather rear chinstrap is carried up round the back of the crown and is not seen from the front; the chrome cap buttons at the ends of the visor strap are","device":"cap-device-cadet-officer-service at device_slot_center (every Honor Guard member, 9.6.7.9)","sibling":"hat-service-cap-honor-guard-chinstrap-down (same cap, strap under the chin)","seating":"same seating as every service cap"},"documented":["male service cap with Cadet Officer cap device and rear chinstrap, worn by all Honor Guard members (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.9, 9.6.1.2)","the black leather rear chin strap is held up by the two chrome cap buttons with the wings up, buckle right of centre seen from the rear; during a performance it is worn down under the chin (9.6.7.9.2)"],"assumed":["all dimensions except the band height","colours sampled from the figure","chinstrap and button size","cloud, bolt and dart ornaments are geometric (cumulus lobes, serrated strip, arrow) laid along the visor edge as on the figure, not the embroidered pattern","visor drawn as a bowl 7.1 in wide and 1.9 in deep (read off the figure, about 1.85 in deep against the 7.4 in band)","crown drawn as an ellipse 11.5 in wide and 2.8 in from its top to the band top: the figure scales to 2.63 in, raised so the 2.375 in device (Vanguard) keeps the figure's clear space above it","cloud centres, sizes and bolt lengths read off the 1860 px figure (u, offset and size tables in build-caps.js), cloud shapes are stylised lobes","the strap up is behind the crown and invisible from the front, so this front view equals the cadet officer cap with the rear chinstrap stowed"],"fit":{"method":"n/a","score":null}}
